snippet.title: LEG DAY: Four Steps Through Hell - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
LEG DAY is a brutal physics-based platformer where you control a single leg and fight your way through four increasingly absurd and dangerous worlds.

Balance, kick, crawl, swim, roll and fly through obstacles, creatures and terrible decisions. Every small step is a victory. Every mistake sends you back down.

Coming soon to PC.

Wishlist now on STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5021490...

#LegDay #IndieGame #PhysicsGame #RageGame #Gamin
